items.title: The blowup algebra after base change is the base change modulo its torsion by the element
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a ring map from R to S, an ideal I and a in I with image b, the lemma identifies the blowup algebra of S at b with the quotient of the base-changed blowup algebra by the elements annihilated by a power of b (statement lines 17400-17406). The proof does not construct a natural isomorphism from universal properties: it defines the target quotient, gets surjectivity because b is a nonzerodivisor in the blowup algebra, and then builds the inverse map explicitly on fractions, checking well-definedness against the kernel of the map from S tensor I^n to J^n, where the torsion condition is exactly what is needed (proof lines 17408-17424). Locating well-definedness in the torsion quotient is the content of the argument. H2.
